name: Accounting & Corporate Finance Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for accounting and corporate finance, covering general ledger (GL), accounts payable (AP), accounts receivable (AR), bank reconciliation, fixed assets depreciation, period close, ASC 606 revenue recognition, and financial consolidation.

checklists.name: Accounting & Financial Close Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for double-entry ledger balance, bank reconciliation, AP/AR aging, and period close financial statements.

items.statement: Every journal entry satisfies double-entry equality (Debits = Credits) with valid COA account dimensions.
Accounts Payable invoices are matched against Purchase Orders and Receiving Slips (3-Way Matching).
Bank statement feeds are reconciled with cash ledger entries and outstanding items flagged.
ASC 606 revenue recognition schedules accurately reflect performance obligation fulfillment.
Period-end trial balance is verified and intercompany balances eliminated prior to financial consolidation.

reviewGates.name: Financial Controller Period Close Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Financial Controller confirms that trial balances, bank reconciliations, and ASC 606 revenue schedules satisfy GAAP/IFRS standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the financial documentation confirm trial balance integrity and period close accuracy?
